time, at any general meeting and by the votes of not less than
two thirds of the members present and voting, to make rules,
not inconsistent with the provision of this Act, or any other
written law, for all or any of the following matters:-

the  classification  of  membership,  admission,
withdrawal, expulsion or resignation of members and
